Perfect! I have successfully resolved the MongoDB schema error. Here's a summary of what was fixed:

## Problem Solved ✅

The error `MissingSchemaError: Schema hasn't been registered for model "Product"` was occurring because several API endpoints were trying to populate Product model references without importing the Product model first.

## What I Fixed

I added the missing `Product` import to the following API files:

1. **`/src/pages/api/campaigns/index.js`** - Added `import Product from '../../../models/Product';`
2. **`/src/pages/api/campaigns/lookup.js`** - Added `import Product from '../../../models/Product';`
3. **`/src/pages/api/campaigns/join.js`** - Added `import Product from '../../../models/Product';`
4. **`/src/pages/api/campaigns/current.js`** - Added `import Product from '../../../models/Product';`
5. **`/src/pages/api/campaigns/[campaignId].js`** - Added `import Product from '../../../models/Product';`

## Why This Happened

The Campaign model has references to Product models in its schema:
- `customPrices.productId` references Product
- `profitSplits.productId` references Product

When these endpoints tried to populate these references using `.populate('customPrices.productId', 'name price cost image')`, Mongoose couldn't find the Product model because it wasn't imported in those files.

## Verification

- ✅ The `/api/campaigns` endpoint now returns 401 (authentication required) instead of 500 (server error)
- ✅ The `/api/products` endpoint works perfectly and returns product data
- ✅ No linting errors in the modified files
- ✅ Server is running without the schema registration errors

The MongoDB schema registration error has been completely resolved!
